description.value: Beachside Motel is part of Skaha Lake Motels, a trio of family-friendly properties clustered on Parkview Street mere steps from Skaha Lake in Penticton's Okanagan Valley. It serves as the central check-in point for all three motels in the group. Guests have direct access to Skaha Lake Park's extensive public amenities including volleyball courts, a waterpark, and a public gym directly opposite the motels.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Beachside Motel at 3624 Parkview Street, Penticton, BC, as part of the 'Skaha Lake Motels' group of three beachside properties. The site explicitly lists 'Free Wifi' under amenities, confirming the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, wash station, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all cycling-related criteria are null.
concerns: The website brand is 'Skaha Lake Motels' (a group of three properties) rather than 'Beachside Motel'; however, 'Beachside Motel' is explicitly named and addressed in the website footer, so this is a group-branding situation, not a phantom listing.

Website contact email for the group is info@skahalakemotels.com while OSM records info@beachsidemotel.ca; the motel-specific email on the website footer matches OSM, so no conflict for this record specifically.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel confirmed open year-round at the listed address in Penticton, directly adjacent to Skaha Lake — a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Okanagan corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Rooms include kitchen and kitchenette options, which may be useful for self-catering cyclists on extended tours. The property explicitly notes cash is not accepted — card or debit only.

wow_evidence: direct access to Skaha Lake Park's extensive public amenities including...a waterpark
